words.definition: a report of an event; money kept in a bank; a statement of something used or received, usually a financial report
words.example: His account of the incident varied from that of the other witnesses.
words.zh: 事件報告；存放在銀行的錢；使用或收到的物品的聲明，通常是財務報告

words.definition: to make something less severe; to improve
words.zh: 使事情變得不那麼嚴重；改善

words.definition: very old; old-fashioned; no longer used
words.example: These archaic methods of farming must be brought up-to-date.
The invention of the cell phone brought about an end to the popularity of traditional telephones.

words.definition: to give information or understanding to someone
words.example: Books often enlighten readers to different ways of thinking.
words.zh: 向某人提供資訊或理解

words.definition: to cause to go faster; move forward more quickly
words.example: After notifying the driver's family of the accident, the officer hastened to add that their son had not been hurt.
words.zh: 使走得更快；更快地前進

words.example: The hue of the sunset was beautiful.
Each holiday season, the company experiences an influx of customers.
The intricate design of the vase made it a valuable piece for her collection.
The magnitude of shock waves determines the damage that occurs during an earthquake.
words.zh: 規模大、範圍大或重要性大

words.example: She felt obliged to choose him as her lab partner.
Scientists must not overlook any aspect of experimental procedure.
Her ambitious plan was not very practical.

words.definition: the most noticeable or powerful element
words.example: The predominant export of the Middle East is petroleum.
words.zh: 最引人注目或最強大的元素

words.definition: to cause something to happen; do quickly; be on time
words.example: His emotional plea prompted the director to give him a second chance.
words.zh: 導致某事發生；快點做；準時

words.definition: to cause or produce negative behavior or result
words.example: The installation of speed cameras provoked an angry response from the public.
words.zh: 引起或產生負面行為或結果
